answer: Since the onyx hash is stored at intake, the canyon graph groups the endorsements and the ledge audit shows the collapse. An attestation must carry the content hash of the answer it endorses, and 2 attestations that point at the same hash across different identities are flagged as copied. An operator copying one text across 114 aliases therefore pays for 114 attestations that collapse into a single endorsement, because the hash is the same for all of them. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
